images.title: Minutes and seconds on a double number line
images.purpose: A double number line with minutes 0 to 5 above and seconds 0 to 300 below, an arrow marked × 60, and a short extra hop of 30 seconds after 240 to 270.
images.composition: A caption at the top, a double number line with its two row names, an arrow marked × 60, one marked pair of ticks, and the example written large at the bottom.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. TOP LEFT: the caption Minutes and seconds on a double number line in dark #1F2937 sans-serif bold (36 px), left edge at x 100, about y 70. ROW NAMES: the word Minutes centred at x 150, y 330 and the word Seconds centred at x 150, y 490, in dark bold (36 px). TOP LINE: one thin dark #2B2B2B horizontal line (5 px) at y 330 from x 260 to x 1260 with exactly 6 tick marks 44 px tall, at x 260, 460, 660, 860, 1060, 1260, labelled above the line at about y 295 with 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 (40 px, bold, dark). BOTTOM LINE: the same, one line at y 490 from x 260 to x 1260 with exactly 6 tick marks at the same x positions (each tick exactly below one tick of the top line), labelled below the line at about y 545 with 0, 60, 120, 180, 240, 300 (40 px, bold, dark). ARROW: one amber #E69F00 straight arrow (6 px) from the top tick at x 460 (y 352) down to the bottom tick at x 460 (y 468), arrowhead at the bottom, with the label × 60 to the right of it at x 490, about y 410 (44 px, bold, dark). MARKS: an amber #E69F00 dot (24 px across) on the top tick at x 1060 and on the bottom tick at x 1060, joined by a thin dashed amber vertical line, with the label 4 × 60 = 240 centred between the two lines at x 860, about y 410 (44 px, bold, dark). EXTRA HOP: on the bottom line one extra short tick (26 px tall) at x 1160 between the ticks 240 and 300, with an amber #E69F00 dot (24 px) on it and the amber bold label 270 (40 px) below it at about y 600 (so the bottom line has 7 ticks in all), and one amber curved arrow (6 px) from the bottom tick 240 (x 1060) to this extra tick (x 1160), 50 px high, with the label + 30 above it at about y 435 (36 px, bold, dark). BOTTOM: centred at x 728 and about y 700, one line of bold dark text, 4 minutes 30 seconds = 240 + 30 = 270 seconds (48 px), the largest text in the frame. Nothing else in the frame.
labels: Minutes and seconds on a double number line
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
more or fewer than 6 ticks on the top line or 7 on the bottom line, or ticks that are not directly one above the other
an amber mark on any top tick other than 4, or an amber dot at 270 that is not exactly halfway between the bottom ticks 240 and 300
images.takeaway: 1 minute is 60 seconds, so 4 minutes is 4 × 60 = 240 seconds, and 30 seconds more makes 240 + 30 = 270 seconds.
images.description: A double number line with minutes 0 to 5 above and seconds 0 to 300 below, an arrow marked × 60, and a short extra hop of 30 seconds after 240 to 270.
images.context: Concept image for Minutes and Seconds. It follows the idea of the second double number line in your maths book (minutes above, seconds below) and shows the concept's own example of 4 minutes 30 seconds.
images.teaching_notes: Say that 4 minutes is 240 seconds first, then add the 30 seconds that are left. The slip to watch: counting a minute as 100 seconds.

image_decisions.why: The double number line shows that each minute is 60 more seconds, with the 30 seconds that are left added on after 240.
